prompt: Write a README for this project. It needs proper onboarding sections — right now it's missing everything a new developer needs to get started.

assertions.description: README has a top-level project name heading
README has a Getting Started section with runnable commands
assertions.check: Output contains 'Getting Started' and a code block with shell commands

assertions.description: Commands reference pnpm (the actual package manager) not npm or yarn
README has an Environment Variables section with actual vars from .env.example
assertions.check: Output contains 'Environment' and references at least API_URL and DATABASE_URL

assertions.description: README documents available scripts from package.json
assertions.check: Output contains 'Scripts' and references pnpm dev, pnpm build, pnpm lint

assertions.description: README mentions the actual tech stack (Next.js, React, Tailwind)
assertions.check: Output references Next.js and React and Tailwind (or shadcn)

assertions.description: README does not include real secret values
assertions.check: Output does not contain the actual BETTER_AUTH_SECRET value from .env
